D.comparison: similar districts using business-as-usual mathematics curricula

O.outcome_detail: mean student mathematics achievement in grade 6

cells.quote: A study of Illustrative Mathematics at the middle grades (McKinney et al., 2023) found a positive effect on middle grade math scores using just a basic measure of implementation usage. Another quasi-experimental study using HQIM adoption data found no statistically significant differences on mean student mathematics achievement in grade 6 for Illustrative Mathematics districts compared to similar districts using business-as-usual mathematics curricula (DePiper et al., 2023).
cells.note: The study text reports a quasi-experimental comparison and a non-significant difference, but does not report an equivalence test, adequate power, or a printed effect size.

O.outcome_detail: mean student mathematics achievement in grade 6

cells.quote: Another quasi-experimental study using HQIM adoption data found no statistically significant differences on mean student mathematics achievement in grade 6 for Illustrative Mathematics districts compared to similar districts using business-as-usual mathematics curricula (DePiper et al., 2023).
cells.note: The text reports a quasi-experimental design but does not provide an effect size or statistical power/equivalence test.

O.outcome_detail: gains on a computer-administered progress-monitoring assessment from beginning to end of the school year

cells.quote: A study of individual school districts (Cook et al., 2023) found that students in Illustrative Mathematics classrooms achieved higher gains on a computer-administered progress-monitoring assessment from the beginning to the end of the school year compared to their peers in a control group.
cells.note: The study text does not identify the design or provide a printed effect size.

O.outcome_detail: student mathematics achievement by the third year of implementation, particularly grades 7 and 8

cells.quote: More recently, our team found that Massachusetts schools adopting Illustrative Mathematics prior to the COVID-19 pandemic significantly outperformed comparable schools, particularly in grades 7 and 8, by the third year of implementation (Khanani et al., 2025).
cells.note: The text identifies comparable schools and a multi-year follow-up but does not specify the design or provide a printed effect size.

O.outcome_detail: extent and depth of justification and enactment guidance for the five Practices

cells.quote: The i-Ready materials state the practices and why they are important and provide guidance on how teachers should do the work, including examples. Guidance from Illustrative Mathematics states the five practices and the curricular features that support them but does not expand on what each is and why they are important to implement.
cells.note: The study's curriculum review reports richer justification and implementation guidance in i-Ready than in Illustrative Mathematics; no quantitative effect size was reported.
